regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and SI availability line
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and aggregate Rh-catalyzed chirality-transfer claim. The article mentions online SI availability, but workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI facts were imported.
Illustrative bioactive/natural cyclopentenones only; no reaction arrow, procedure, condition, or current-paper experimental outcome is present.
Three prior-work reaction classes were classified separately: proximal-bond APKR, distal-bond Rh APKR, and formal Alder-ene/triene formation. They are not current-paper experiments.
The two cited chirality-transfer examples remain literature records. The lower [RhCl(CO)2]2/AgSbF6/CO arrow is the generic current transformation; table rows provide experiment-specific runs.

unresolved: Scheme 2 prior-work structures and R groups are generic and do not define uniquely executable experiments.
No SI association was inferred from the availability sentence.

regions.finding: Narrative continuation classifies cited distal-bond APKR, inert/CO-atmosphere Alder-ene chemistry, and earlier low/partial chirality-transfer reports; no new current-paper run is introduced here.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–12, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Twelve independent optimization experiments were retained with catalyst/silver identity, 0.2 mmol scale, 2 mL toluene, CO, row temperature/time, NMR versus isolated yields, E/Z ratios, recoveries, and the 10 min in-situ catalyst-generation operation. Entry 12's prose explicitly resolves 3a as not detected.

The cited CuBr2 EATA precursor class and ten separate current substitution preparations of (Ra)-1a–1j were classified. Product yields/ee and the depicted 0 °C-to-room-temperature programs were retained; unprinted stage times remain missing.
The 11 h and 9 h optically active 0.2 mmol runs are introduced here and linked to the two Table 2 rows on page 3. They remain distinct from the later 0.5 mmol detailed experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 3 omits scale, reagent quantities, stage times, workup, purification, masses, and yield basis.
Table 1 catalyst-preactivation temperature is not printed for entries 4–12.

regions.finding: Two distinct 0.2 mmol time-study experiments were retained: 11 h gives (R)-2a in 80%/89% ee and 9 h gives 79%/94% ee under the shared Rh/Ag/CO/toluene/5 °C conditions.
ORTEP of (R)-2a establishes the source absolute-configuration assignment and characterizes Table 3 entry 1; it is not another preparation or machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 3 lower Table 3 entries 1–10 and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten independent substrate-scope experiments were retained with substrate/linker/substituent labels, starting ee, row temperature/time, isolated desired/byproduct yields, product ee, and scale footnotes. Entries 6/8 use 0.2 mmol; all others use 0.5 mmol.
The Int1–Int8/Int4' catalytic cycle is a proposed mechanism with desired-product and beta-H-elimination branches, not a collection of isolated experiments.

unresolved: Most Table 2/3 rows omit operational workup, purification, and product masses.
The Table 3 shared 5 mL toluene statement remains attached to 0.2 mmol entries because no replacement volume is printed.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Scheme 4 mechanism
regions.finding: Completes the proposed cyclometallation/CO-insertion/reductive-elimination route to 2 and competing beta-H-elimination route to triene 3; no intermediate is treated as an isolated preparation.

regions.region: page 4 left Experimental Section detailed (Ra)-1a to (R)-2a procedure
regions.finding: Merged into Table 3 entry 1: exact Rh/Ag/substrate masses and mmol, separate 3+2 mL toluene portions, glove-box charging, three CO cycles, 5 °C/10 min preactivation, 5 °C/1 min dropwise addition, 5 °C/9 h hold, silica-pad/30 mL ether workup, chromatography, 190.9 mg/94%, 159–160 °C, and 94% ee HPLC.
Shihua Song is thanked for reproducing Table 3 products (R)-2g and (R)-2i, but no independent charges, conditions, yields, or run identifiers are given; no duplicate experiments were created.

regions.region: page 4 right references and footnote 15 beginning
regions.finding: Bibliography is prior-literature context. Footnote 15 begins crystallographic data for the existing (R)-2a assignment; it is characterization, not a reaction or SI association.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable runs.
The crystal footnote prints '(Ra)-2a' while the product/Figure use '(R)-2a'.
Glove-box gas identity and durations of evacuation/refill cycles are not reported.
